onboardingEvidence.provenance: On 2026-09-02 the official careers page's Search All Jobs link opened https://www.cirrus.com/careers/jobs. Its rendered page displayed 113 opportunities and linked each posting to https://jobs.eu.lever.co/cirrus/<uuid>. The official corporate page was readable in the browser despite direct corporate fetches returning 403.
onboardingEvidence.listingEvidence: Anonymous GET without a limit returned all 113 postings, equal to both the corporate Displaying 113 opportunities count and 113 distinct posting links on the hosted Lever board. Pagination uses limit and skip; GET ?mode=json&limit=100&skip=100 returned the final 13 rows. Top level is an array, not an object with a total.
onboardingEvidence.descriptionEvidence: Descriptions are inline. descriptionPlain contains the introduction and summary; lists[].text/content carries responsibilities and qualifications, and additionalPlain contains further conditions. The reader must retain all sections, rather than treating descriptionPlain alone as the full job description.
onboardingEvidence.robots: Both https://api.eu.lever.co/robots.txt and https://jobs.eu.lever.co/robots.txt returned User-agent: *, Allow: /, Crawl-delay: 1. requestDelayMs is 1000; URL guards remain enabled.
onboardingEvidence.headquartersEvidence: Official company release identifies headquarters in Austin, Texas.
onboardingEvidence.tagsEvidence: The company describes its high-precision, low-power analog and mixed-signal processing solutions for audio, sensing and haptics.
onboardingEvidence.notes: The integration owner's Lever reader now infers api.eu.lever.co from the official jobs.eu.lever.co base URL and includes description, responsibility/qualification lists, and additional text. Admission requires a passing generated full proof. No shared files were changed by this task.
